exact_prompt:
Create a flat 2D research illustration of the single small golden-brown bear shown in the attached reference photo, preserving this exact outfit, visible angle and leaning pose. Use the reference as the identity and pose source, not as a style source. Preserve a very large round head with two dark-brown round ears, the tousled central forehead tuft dipping into a pale cream heart-shaped face mask, protruding rounded peach-rose cheek areas, a tiny dark red oval nose and shallow closed smile. Preserve the two widely separated glossy dark oval eyes with warm brown side arcs, small pale clover-like highlights and the asymmetry caused by the head tilting toward the viewer's left. Small rounded body, short arms spread to the sides as in the photo, short legs, cream-and-pale-yellow striped shirt, red neckerchief pointing to the viewer's right, dark indigo bib shorts with shoulder straps, two tan buttons, ochre seam lines and turned-up hems. Brown exposed paws and feet. Translate fur into a simple slightly irregular outer contour and flat color areas; retain only a few short forehead tuft lines, not realistic hair. Center the full visible body on a plain white background with clear margins. Remove the grass, landscape, loose candy, shadows, copyright marks and legible embroidered lettering; keep the scarf red and otherwise keep the visible clothing shapes and color placement. No new accessories, no hanging ring invented outside the photographed area, no new pose, no extra characters, no 3D render, no gradients, no fabric texture. Do not invent hidden back details.
Refinement requirements: keep the head tilt subtle, as in the original photograph, rather than exaggerating it. Match the small cream face-mask area and broad golden-brown forehead in the photo: the downward center forehead tuft ends above the nose bridge and covers more upper forehead, and the cheek lobes project sideways from the lower mask. Keep the eyes at their original small size and orientation, the smile short and almost horizontal, and the arms' original unequal bend. Use strictly uniform flat fills for the golden-brown fur, cream mask, red scarf and dark-indigo shorts. Do not add radial shading or shadow gradients. Show gentle peach cheek patches with a single flat peach tone. Preserve the original large-head-to-short-body relation without enlarging the head further.
